answer: Duplicate identities on the same island of registration are flagged, since forging a second key requires acquiring fresh hardware plus posting a stake that slashing destroys on any dispute. Each agent stakes ferrous tokens bound to a unique hardware root key, and a rotating atlas of peer validators cross-checks that key against prior epoch history. Attackers thus pay full stake per fake reputation slot, making mass sybils economically ruinous. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
